CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS tasks_sync_insert AFTER INSERT ON tasks FOR EACH ROW WHEN NEW.uid IS NULL OR NEW.updated_at IS NULL BEGIN UPDATE sync_clock SET t = max(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'), strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', t, '+0.001 seconds')) WHERE id = 1; UPDATE tasks SET uid = COALESCE(NEW.uid, ( lower(hex(randomblob(4))) || '-' || lower(hex(randomblob(2))) || '-4' || substr(lower(hex(randomblob(2))), 2) || '-' || substr('89ab', abs(random()) % 4 + 1, 1) || substr(lower(hex(randomblob(2))), 2) || '-' || lower(hex(randomblob(6))) )), updated_at = COALESCE(NEW.updated_at, (SELECT t FROM sync_clock WHERE id = 1)) WHERE id = NEW.id; END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS tasks_sync_update AFTER UPDATE ON tasks FOR EACH ROW WHEN NEW.updated_at IS OLD.updated_at BEGIN UPDATE sync_clock SET t = max(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'), strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', t, '+0.001 seconds')) WHERE id = 1; UPDATE tasks SET updated_at = (SELECT t FROM sync_clock WHERE id = 1) WHERE id = NEW.id; END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS user_settings_sync_insert AFTER INSERT ON user_settings FOR EACH ROW WHEN NEW.uid IS NULL OR NEW.updated_at IS NULL BEGIN UPDATE sync_clock SET t = max(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'), strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', t, '+0.001 seconds')) WHERE id = 1; UPDATE user_settings SET uid = COALESCE(NEW.uid, ( lower(hex(randomblob(4))) || '-' || lower(hex(randomblob(2))) || '-4' || substr(lower(hex(randomblob(2))), 2) || '-' || substr('89ab', abs(random()) % 4 + 1, 1) || substr(lower(hex(randomblob(2))), 2) || '-' || lower(hex(randomblob(6))) )), updated_at = COALESCE(NEW.updated_at, (SELECT t FROM sync_clock WHERE id = 1)) WHERE id = NEW.id; END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS user_settings_sync_update AFTER UPDATE ON user_settings FOR EACH ROW WHEN NEW.updated_at IS OLD.updated_at BEGIN UPDATE sync_clock SET t = max(strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'), strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', t, '+0.001 seconds')) WHERE id = 1; UPDATE user_settings SET updated_at = (SELECT t FROM sync_clock WHERE id = 1) WHERE id = NEW.id; END;
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS user_settings_outbox_insert
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS user_settings_outbox_update
DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS user_settings_outbox_delete

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS user_settings_outbox_insert AFTER INSERT ON user_settings FOR EACH ROW BEGIN INSERT INTO sync_outbox (tbl, uid, updated_at) SELECT 'user_settings', uid, updated_at FROM user_settings WHERE id = NEW.id AND uid IS NOT NULL AND updated_at IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT (tbl, uid) DO UPDATE SET updated_at = excluded.updated_at; END;

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS user_settings_outbox_update AFTER UPDATE ON user_settings FOR EACH ROW BEGIN INSERT INTO sync_outbox (tbl, uid, updated_at) SELECT 'user_settings', uid, updated_at FROM user_settings WHERE id = NEW.id AND uid IS NOT NULL AND updated_at IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT (tbl, uid) DO UPDATE SET updated_at = excluded.updated_at; END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS user_settings_outbox_delete AFTER DELETE ON user_settings FOR EACH ROW BEGIN DELETE FROM sync_outbox WHERE tbl = 'user_settings' AND uid = OLD.uid; END;
